scope: 112 rank-local target-to-next-target periods; accepted CP+slot+CPUplan cohort. Target-only groups exclude three draft blocks; other named groups specify their phase. No cross-rank sums.

historical_eager.scope: Historical v168 first-token eager target; 4 enclosing HcPre-to-HcPost bodies per rank. The denominator for each row is its corresponding body. Separate HCCL protocol records are outside this compute extract.

method: Per rank/period take the union of clock intervals for each matching key; rate uses that same local period. All rank/periods enter the screen. No device samples were added.
limits: If a proposal solely shortens matched native tasks, this is its observed device-time budget before replacement. A service claim needs request-level exposure. A change to host submission, overlaps, payload, a common producer, cache ownership or a downstream dependency needs the full affected region.

Different signatures can overlap. Use a union over original task IDs for a combined proposal. Keys with missing dtype/shape fields retain N/A, including collectives; consult the payload crosswalk. Layout and physical traffic are not inferred.
No inference for uncaptured branches, other firmware/runtime, other workloads or all-pair independence. The 1% local guide is an investigation choice.
